items.html: And also this matter depends for its reason on what was said above, that the four couplings are not equal: for in the morning ZA is complete and filled with all these Mochin, all of them; therefore that coupling is excellent, and it is the coupling of Jacob and Rachel. But in the other couplings, according to the value of the Mochin that he takes, so is the value of that coupling — whether it is the coupling of Israel with Leah, or of Jacob with Leah, and the like.
